title: yay mod
description: this is a mod that add alot of yay items, blocks, and other
body:
this is my first ever mod! its not my best work but i hope you like it
features:
adds yay tools ( sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe,)
adds yay ore blocks. when you mine yay ore you smelt it into raw yay ore.
you can eat raw yay ore. and if you smelt raw yay ore to get a yay ingot.
yay ore will make you walk realy fast. and the ya_yblock2 will make you run so fast you will deload world. to get ya_yblock2 you need to smelt a yay block into a yay stair. then smelt a yay stair into a yay slab. then smelt a yay slab into a yay fence. then smelt a yay button into a ya_yblock2. yes you must smelt all of that to get a ya_yblock2.

this mod also adds a yay dimension the terrain mimics the overworld terrain.

there is a yay house/vilmans house. there is a vilager in there that will trade a dirt for a yay ore block.
theres a ruined yay portal structure
